What changed, and why

Shared action colors

Was

Seven literal tints bypassed the app palette; matching trade decision controls used separate literal colors.

Now

Booking, extension and trade actions use the shared adaptive status tokens.

Native row activation

Was

Home attention and Trade Board details relied on gestures with manually added button traits.

Now

Native buttons own navigation; Home quick actions and Trade Board Claim/Approve/Decline remain unnested siblings. Full times and warnings stay accessible.

A clear formatting boundary

Was

Trade Board’s private area property already held formatted text but looked like a raw server token to the detector.

Now

areaLabel names display-ready text. Raw shift areas remain unchanged and are formatted once during projection.

Verification

  • Unchanged drift detector: zero findings across 130 Swift files.
  • Repository ios:xcode:verify passed: generated project, 82/82 audit coverage, simulator build, 251/251 native tests. Generic-device compilation was intentionally excluded for this Simulator request.
  • Focused source checks: 794/794; touched TypeScript test lint, docs/codemaps and git diff --check: passed.
  • Six UI cases passed across targeted runs: Home route, staff review, student available, student waiting, native details versus inline decision, extension failure and retry preservation. ui-latest-cases.json identifies the latest passing result for every case.
  • Independent source review: no actionable regressions.
  • Matched light and dark PNGs inspected; runtime-captures.json verifies installed binary hashes.

Things to know

  • This follow-up supersedes the earlier review’s remaining style-drift boundary. The detector script was not relaxed or edited.
  • Synthetic local API fixtures verify rendering and interaction, not authenticated record persistence or physical-device behavior. No production mutations, migration, deployment, distribution, commit or push occurred.
  • Unrelated Wrapped UIScreen.main deprecation and Xcode operating-system build diagnostics remain; the build and native test results pass.
  • Work remains unstaged on codex/ios-review-fixes; original root and prior feature/onboarding work are preserved.
